model.summary: Model favors WAS by 2.3 points (58% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (WAS +1.5), Home team off a bye (PHI +1.2), Quarterback rating (WAS +0.9). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 44.3 total points (WAS 23, PHI 21). Biggest factors: Divisional game (lowers total 0.7), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.6), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
